verdict.rationale: DBOS ships as an official open-source library: a Python package installed via pip, documented in a Python programming guide, and offering a DBOSClient for programmatic access. Community users corroborate building with the Python SDK and note TypeScript is also supported. Missing for 10: first-party evidence in the pack for the TypeScript SDK (only a community mention) and breadth beyond Python/TypeScript (e.g., no .NET).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: you install the open-source library and annotate workflows and steps.
DBOSClient provides a programmatic way to interact with your DBOS application from external code or from another DBOS application.
you can use DBOS to add durable workflows and queues to your program in just a few lines of code.
I built a small side thing using DBOS (using python SDK) and the ergonomics were pretty nice.
Languages that are supported: Typescript and Python.
